summary: Schema-driven WinUI/.NET desktop application that lets a single operator build, edit, and run CLI command workflows via a guided wizard. Stores TOML tool schemas and a local history, can import help text or completion data, and ships as a locally-signed MSIX for Windows 10+.
ecosystem_role: local-first, operator-centric desktop utility for schema-driven CLI command construction and management
capabilities: guided wizard UI for constructing commands
import help text and completion scripts to generate schemas
edit and persist tool TOML schemas
interfaces: file system for schema and history storage (LocalAppData Aptlantis/CommandWizard)
Process invocation for capturing CLI help/completions
consumes: pasted or captured CLI help text
